info.name: Hospigo 7b settings
info.description: Step 7b (API): the settings screens: OPD rules (free follow-up days, free repeat-visit hours), registration fields (standard and own fields, dropdown choices) and the patient number (UHID) format. BEFORE RUNNING: (1) the dev seed has been run (NODE_ENV=development npm run prisma:seed -w @hospigo/api) (2) the API runs on port 3000. Select the Hospigo Local environment (staffPassword and superadminPassword), then Run collection. About 3 logins count against the login IP limit (20 per minute). The collection puts everything back: the OPD rules and the number format are restored, the fields it adds are switched off (fields are never deleted, by design), and it registers ONE patient to prove the new number format is really used.

item.name: 0 Setup
1 Login Receptionist (north main)

exec: pm.test('select the Hospigo Local environment: staffPassword and superadminPassword must be set', () => { pm.expect(pm.variables.get('staffPassword'), 'staffPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.variables.get('superadminPassword'), 'superadminPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: 2 Login SuperAdmin (north)
3 Login SuperAdmin (south, another hospital)
1 OPD rules
4 Read the rules (SuperAdmin) and remember them
5 Receptionist cannot read (403)
6 Receptionist cannot change (403)
7 No token = 401
8 Change both rules
9 Read again: the new values are kept

exec: pm.test('11 and 36', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.followUpFreeDays).to.eql(11); pm.expect(j.repeatVisitFreeHours).to.eql(36); });

item.name: 10 Out of range is refused (366 days)
11 A fraction is refused
12 An empty body is refused
13 The other hospital is not changed

exec: pm.test('south does not have 11 and 36 from us', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.followUpFreeDays === 11 && j.repeatVisitFreeHours === 36).to.eql(false); });

item.name: 14 Put the original rules back
2 Registration fields
15 List the fields (SuperAdmin)

exec: pm.test('name is locked on and required', () => { pm.expect(name.alwaysRequired).to.eql(true); pm.expect(name.isEnabled).to.eql(true); pm.expect(name.isRequired).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 16 Receptionist cannot read the settings (403)
17 Receptionist cannot add a field (403)
18 Name cannot be made optional (locked)
19 Unknown standard field = 404
20 Make gender required
21 The registration form now says gender is required (receptionist)

exec: pm.test('gender required in the form', () => pm.expect(g.required).to.eql(true));

item.name: 22 Put gender back as it was
23 Add a text field of our own

exec: pm.test('a field with its own code', () => { pm.expect(j.code).to.match(/^cf_/); pm.expect(j.isEnabled).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.options).to.eql([]); });

item.name: 24 The same name again is refused
25 A dropdown without choices is refused
26 Add a dropdown with two choices

exec: pm.test('two choices in order', () => pm.expect(j.options.map(o => o.label)).to.eql(['Yes','No']));

item.name: 27 The registration form (receptionist) now asks for both

exec: pm.test('both own fields are in the form', () => { pm.expect(codes.some(c => c.startsWith('cf_pm7b_field'))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(codes.some(c => c.startsWith('cf_pm7b_choice'))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 28 Rename a choice and switch the other off (never deleted)

exec: pm.test('renamed, and the other is off but kept', () => { pm.expect(o.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('dYes')).label).to.eql('Yes, insured'); const no = o.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('dNo')); pm.expect(no.isActive).to.eql(false); });

item.name: 29 At least one choice must stay on
30 Choices cannot be set on a text field
31 Another hospital cannot change our field (404)
32 Another hospital cannot see our fields in its form

exec: pm.test('south has no pm7b fields', () => pm.expect(codes.some(c => c.indexOf('pm7b') >= 0)).to.eql(false));

item.name: 33 Clean up: switch our text field off
34 Clean up: switch our dropdown off
35 The form no longer asks for them
3 Patient number (UHID) format
36 Read the format in use and remember it

exec: pm.test('a format is set, with a sample and the limits', () => { pm.expect(j.configured).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.example).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.limits.maxBlocks).to.eql(12); });

item.name: 37 Receptionist cannot read it (403)
38 Receptionist cannot change it (403)
39 A format without a running number is refused
40 Text with a space is refused
41 Restarting every year needs a year part
42 Start a new format PM-000001

exec: pm.test('the sample is in the new format', () => pm.expect(j.example).to.eql('PM-000001'));
pm.test('the next number is in the new format and never goes back', () => pm.expect(j.next).to.match(/^PM-\d{6}$/));

item.name: 43 Register a patient: the number uses the new format

exec: pm.test('the UHID is in the new format', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().uhid).to.match(/^PM-\d{6}$/));

item.name: 44 The other hospital keeps its own format
45 Put the original format back
